exports.summary: reserve `len` bytes; returns ptr, or null over the request/outstanding limits

exports.name: gl_free
exports.summary: release a buffer previously handed out by gl_alloc or gl_call

exports.name: gl_call
exports.summary: run one request; consumes the buffer; returns (out_ptr << 32) | out_len

frame.prior_hash_semantics: BLAKE3 of the preceding frame's to_hash_bytes; genesis is BLAKE3 of 32 zero bytes

abi_manifest.notes: op `duckdb` (op-15) dispatches inside the module on every target; the gates that compiled that dispatch arm out of wasm32 are removed. It is unadvertised from `capabilities.ops` (and stays off the hashed 14-op table) by digest-stability choice, so `registry_blake3` does not move until an explicit digest bump — not because the op is host-only. The wasm `capabilities.authorities` list now includes `frozen-duckdb` (as the host list already did). Absence from `capabilities.ops` is not a SQL refusal and is not REFUSAL-04. SQL-in-RDF admits inside the module through `compile_turtle`. Bounds enforced in src/duckdb_op.rs: DuckDB memory_limit=32MiB and threads=1 compile-time pragmas (GAP-2), chunk rows <= 10000 and chunk bytes <= 16 MiB typed ResourceLimit refusals (GAP-4), MAX_OUTSTANDING_ALLOC_BYTES is 16 MiB for the wasm32 target via split-config (GAP-1)

invariants: non-tabular query columnar null digest: CANON_ARROW_EMPTY_V1 (BLAKE3(b'CANON_ARROW_EMPTY_V1'))
frame length exceeding ceiling terminates with exit code 92 without body allocation
zero host credential exposure: WASI context runs with empty environment (no inherit_env)
unbounded UPDATE/DELETE without WHERE rejected with REFUSAL-01
SQL comments preceding ATTACH rejected with REFUSAL-06
deterministic 64-byte alignment with zero-byte padding for all Arrow IPC buffers
CAS epoch monotonicity on all DDL/DML state mutations

REFUSAL-01.description: The graph AST fails strict closed-world SHACL shape validation before admission: missing or non-integer `sql:statementIndex`, empty/missing `sql:from`, missing projection list, malformed/unclosed RDF list, unexpected terminal node, recursion-limit breach, more than one expression discriminator per node, a token outside the §4 operator enum (`Operator::from_token`), or a non-`sql:Scope` individual.
REFUSAL-01.name: MalformedAstRefusal

REFUSAL-02.description: A dialect statement kind parsed from the grammar (`ggen/sql-dialect/sql_statement_kinds.rs`) is recognized but has no evaluation path in this DuckDB build — currently `ConnectStatement`, `DisconnectStatement`.
REFUSAL-02.name: UnimplementedStatementRefusal

REFUSAL-03.description: Scope discrimination boundary violated (rec §1.3): an aggregate in a `WHERE`/`JOIN`/`GROUP BY` position, a `sql:ProcessScope` column in the projection list, or a `sql:ViewScope` column inside a predicate — including `HAVING` (`ViewScope` at `src/sql_ast.rs:284-295`, arm `VIEW_SCOPE_IN_PREDICATE = 5`), an explicit scope annotation on an aggregate argument beneath a predicate-rooted aggregate (arm `SCOPE_IN_PRED_AGG_ARG = 6`, `src/sql_ast.rs:304-311` — laundering marker: the argument position is process-only, so the annotation can only re-scope the aggregate's output past the gate; recovery: drop the scope annotation on the aggregate argument), or a MERGE `ON` condition referencing no target-qualified column (`MERGE_ON_NO_TARGET_COLUMN = 7`, `src/sql_ast.rs:987-993` — a constant-only ON like `$1 = $2` matches every target row and makes WHEN MATCHED fan-out unbounded; recovery: qualify the ON condition to at least one target column, e.g. `t.id = s.id`).
REFUSAL-03.name: ScopeIntegrityRefusal

REFUSAL-04.description: Builtin SQL eval was given a reader that is not document-backed. The wasm module still admits and compiles SQL-in-RDF through `compile_turtle`, the same path as the other dialects.
REFUSAL-04.name: CapabilityRefusal

REFUSAL-05.description: UPDATE/DELETE statement node with neither `sql:whereColumn` nor `sql:whereValue` — refused at compile, zero engine contact. (Appended 2026-10-23, append-only per convention — never renumbered.) Receipt: `receipts/2026-10-23-eh-closure-wave.md` (W11/W18: REFUSAL-05 pins re-landed 36/0; register row landed W7/W25, no renumbering).
REFUSAL-05.name: UnboundedMutationRefusal

REFUSAL-06.description: SQL statement attempting to bypass ATTACH/COPY allowlist via SQL comments (/* */ or --)
REFUSAL-06.name: SQLCommentBypassAttempt
